text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With after-school training complete, I
head over to the water
fountain. There, I
spot Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Now that feels good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I just put my head under the
faucet! Nothing beats a cold
shower after
training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wanna give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man... But it feels so good on the
shoulder muscles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she smiles back at me,
I notice her eyes
look a little red...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
O-of course not! Why would I be...
crying...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears well up in her eyes as she struggles
to remain calm. I decide to
give her some
space until she settles down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You've got sharp eyes, you know
that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You see... I keep losing to McQueen in
scrimmages.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try,
I just can't catch
up to her. It's just so... so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Frustrating...
Guess winning isn't as easy as
it seems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking closer, I notice that Mejiro Ryan
appears more gaunt than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of our training, she also works out
on her own. If she's not
properly fueling
her body...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uh... I think so? At least,
I'm pretty
sure I ate breakfast today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well... That makes it abundantly clear. As
her trainer, there's only one
thing for me
to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria is mostly deserted this
late in
the day. I notice Mejiro
Ryan idly looking
about the room, perhaps out of boredom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the XXL pork cutlet curry I
ordered is placed before her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! T-Trainer, what's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
B-but eating this late in the day isn't
good
for—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, if you insist. I mean, it does look good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan devours the massive curry dish
in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mmm... mmmmm!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My tongue's screaming in delight... I can
feel my muscles thanking me
for all the
extra protein!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it... I have been a bit too preoccupied with racing lately. I don't know how long it's been since I last sat down to a full meal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I guess when I'm frustrated, I tend to
forget important stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not uncommon for runners to put too
much focus on their failures,
causing them
to neglect their health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once she opens her eyes and realizes what
she's doing, I'm sure Ryan
will see what a
disservice she's doing to herself and her
potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My talent...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan stares out the window at the
girls passing by, deep in
thought.
